thread.title: Vance Reaffirms Full Confidence in Hegseth, Highlights Military Recruiting Trends
thread.title_full: Vance Reaffirms Full Confidence in Hegseth, Highlights Military Recruiting Trends

author: Congo
text: Not sure about Hegseth but if he and Vance think the recruiting slump is over the nation is in big trouble. Certainly not making the numbers and among the numbers that are made the other numbers (ASVAB) are among the worst since the peak of the Vietnam War, certainly among the worst of the All Volunteer Army (AVA) and similar word tricks used by other military branches. (ASVAB: Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery is a high school level competency at 1960s draftee level.) On the other hand the Pentagon is doing everything possible to denigrate fair pay, allowances, living conditions. Note to VP Vance and the SIGNAL crew: show us results don't tell us about them. Try using DOGE to check the effects of short changing military members: premier question: "Are we paying and providing the military personnel what they are worth at the enlisted level?" Ask the enlisted and NCOs in the field and on ships at sea. Do not look for answers reading Military.com the Pentagon mouthpiece posing as a real newspaper. A salute to all who serve.
